summary: Practise BIA, recovery planning and incident coordination with ISO 22301:2019. Explore the five-day course and its applied exercises.
lede: Business continuity planning training helps continuity practitioners, managers and functional leads assess disruption impacts and set recovery priorities. Participants identify critical activities from business impact analysis records, map dependencies, assess recovery strategy feasibility, draft continuity procedures and practise crisis coordination through situation reports, decision logs and exercises, using ISO 22301:2019 and ISO 22320:2018.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who maintain continuity arrangements, coordinate disruption response or connect business priorities with technology and supplier recovery. It suits those who already work with operational processes and need a more consistent approach to BIA, plan upkeep, exercises and corrective actions.
prerequisites: Designed for intermediate-level continuity and crisis practitioners, managers and functional leads with working familiarity with operational processes or continuity responsibilities. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use BIA and planning artefacts with spreadsheets and word-processing documents.
